_comment: DataSkate named reference clients — companies DataSkate is authorized to cite by name in competitive evaluations, proposals, and social proof. Each entry tracks what DataSkate built for them, how they may be referenced, and which prospect engagements have received this company as a reference.

_schema.slug: kebab-case — must match client-registry.json slug if client is registered there
_schema.displayName: Full legal or trading name as it appears in sales materials
_schema.industry: industry vertical for matching against prospects
_schema.systems: systems known to be in use — used to match reference to prospect platform overlap
_schema.whatDataSkateBuilt: 1-3 sentences — what DataSkate built or is building for this client
_schema.authorizedUsage: how this reference may be used in sales contexts
_schema.contactForReference: who to direct prospects to when requesting a reference call (name / email / note)
_schema.referencedTo: array of client slugs who have received this company as a named reference in proposals or sales conversations
_schema.addedDate: ISO date when added to this registry
_schema.notes: any caveats, restrictions, or context about using this reference

references.whatDataSkateBuilt: Active Celigo + NetSuite integration engagement. Clorox uses Celigo as enterprise iPaaS middleware for third-party system integrations, specifically CloudExtend by Celigo for NetSuite implementations. DataSkate is working on integration connecting business applications, streamlining data workflows, and automating processes across their enterprise tech stack.
references.authorizedUsage: Name directly in competitive evaluations where the prospect is using Celigo + NetSuite and is evaluating iPaaS vendors. Frame as: 'We are actively working with The Clorox Company on a Celigo and NetSuite integration engagement right now.' Do not describe as completed.
bestUsedFor: Prospects migrating off Celigo to MuleSoft
Prospects using NetSuite as their ERP
Competitive evaluations where DataSkate needs to prove enterprise-scale Celigo expertise

references.notes: Enterprise scale (Fortune 500) makes this the strongest possible credibility anchor for mid-market Celigo migration prospects. Clorox's name carries weight regardless of whether the prospect knows the company's tech stack — it signals that DataSkate works at enterprise scale.

howToUse.matchingLogic: When a prospect is in a competitive evaluation, Vera reads this file and checks systems[] overlap with sage.json systems[]. Any reference client with 1+ system overlap and referenceType != 'stub' is a candidate credentialing anchor.
howToUse.referencedToTracking: When a reference client is named in a proposal or sales conversation, add the prospect's slug to that client's referencedTo[] array in this file. This lets DataSkate track reference load (avoid overusing the same reference) and maintain relationship awareness.
howToUse.agentAccess: Vera reads this file in Step 4 (credentialing anchor check). Hawk reads it via competitivePositioning principle. Neither agent modifies it — updates to referencedTo[] are made by the pipeline operator (Vivek) or by the orchestrate.js post-hawk step.
